Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Contemporary Side Table with Bookshelf, 21.6"W, Black Oak
Colors: Black Oak
Materials: Metal
This square table brings functionality to any room with 1 side devoted to shelving that is great for storing books or other items. The height allows it to be used as a side table or a small desk. Butt joints connect the legs and shelving, adding a modern look to the sleek black finish. 21.6"W x 21.6"D x 25.6"H Engineered wood with metal This stylish table offers a modern look and functionality great for any room. Shelving on 1 side of this table makes it great as a side table or a desk in any room. Assemble in 15-30 minutes Wipe with a soft cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
